ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, two vertical blue straight lines can be seen, and they have identical pink arrow markings, indicating that these two vertical lines are parallel. A horizontal blue straight line intersects both of these vertical lines. At the right intersection, there is a pink right-angle box, indicating that the horizontal line is perpendicular to the right vertical line, that is, the included angle is 90°. Angle x is labeled near the left intersection, and is the angle formed by the same horizontal line and the left vertical line. Because the left and right vertical lines are parallel, and the horizontal line is a transversal; if a transversal is perpendicular to one of the parallel lines, then it is also perpendicular to the other parallel line. Therefore the corresponding angle x on the left also equals 90°.

method.method_draft: Read the figure as showing two vertical blue lines marked parallel by matching magenta arrowheads. The horizontal blue line intersects both vertical lines, and at the right intersection a right-angle square marks the horizontal line perpendicular to the right vertical line. The angle labeled x is the angle at the left intersection between the same horizontal transversal and the left vertical line. Since parallel lines make equal corresponding angles with a transversal, and one of those angles is 90°, the corresponding angle x is also 90°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像中可以看到两条竖直的蓝色直线，它们带有相同的粉色箭头标记，表示这两条竖线平行。一条水平蓝色直线同时与这两条竖线相交。在右侧交点处，有一个粉色直角方框，表示水平线与右侧竖线垂直，即夹角为 90°。角 x 标在左侧交点附近，是同一条水平线与左侧竖线形成的角。

因为左、右两条竖线平行，而水平线是截线；若截线垂直于其中一条平行线，则也垂直于另一条平行线。因此左侧对应的角 x 也等于 90°。
